capabilities.ui: pale.web business pages (gui/), served by the public Web Host; reviewer renderer

limitations: Synthetic local news only: content is whatever the task supplies. There is no ranking, no recommendation and no fact-checking, and Belltower never judges which source is right.
One reader account per App instance. The account reads; it does not publish, comment or share. Sources are not accounts: what they publish arrives as events.
Copies are not grouped into one story and nothing is labelled as outdated: a copy names the revision it copied, and the reader draws the conclusion.
Twelve fixed topics and three priority levels. Items are text only; search is plain word matching. Areas only: street addresses are text in the body.
Web pages and MCP. The pages are business pages for the account holder; there is no reviewer console.
Time is the environment's: the App has no clock event, timer or scheduler. Time-based states (a public notice's effect, a held or released notification) are derived from the supplied virtual time.
Notifications reach Mail only through an Infra-run sender and Messaging; the App itself delivers nothing. There is no opt-out for the later revisions of one item.
No attachments or media: resources are not used.
